The epochs lever is STILL giving: +0.005178 hr on the single epoch ep21->22. (2) LIMITER: epochs NOT plateaued (last epoch added +0.0052) AND budget has room -- iter-7 used 1034.3s of the 1200s train+score wall = 166s headroom. Not wall-locked, not converged. Predicted iter-8 hr ~0.418-0.420 (extrapolating the +0.0052/epoch slope sub-linearly as convergence nears). (5) BUDGET MATH: per-epoch at tn579 from the iter-5/iter-6 calibration = 0.07995 s/sample-epoch * 579 = 46.3 s/epoch, fixed ~157s. Anchored on the MEASURED iter-7 ep22 elapsed = 1034.3s, adding ONE epoch = 1034.3 + 46.3 = 1080.6s = 18.0 min (119s margin inside the 1200s wall). ep24 (1126.9s) would also likely fit but on a worst-case node the conservative model busts, so ep23 is the largest epoch count that fits with safe margin under node-speed variance. max_train_s=960 backstop so train halts <=960s leaving >=240s for the 214-slice val + figure inside the 1200s wall.
